title: Campfire Ban in Effect
body: A [fire ban](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/bc/pacificrim/bulletins/a0ecce7a-e78a-4271-bd96-58c8bbf9c914) is in effect for the West Coast Trail starting July 16th at noon until further notice. No campfires are allowed, but backpacking propane stoves are permitted.

title: Bear in area warning
body: Parks Canada issued a [Warning notice](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/bc/pacificrim/bulletins/7947b16d-253e-4fcd-a2a5-7fb33efc429c) for bear activity between Pachena Bay and Darling River.
